sloka: स वानरगणैस्तैस्तु वृतः परमदुर्जयः।लक्ष्मणानुचरो रामः सम्प्रतस्थे महावलः ।। ६.६७.१२४ ।।
transliteration: sa vānaragaṇaistaistu vṛtaḥ paramadurjayaḥ।lakṣmaṇānucaro rāmaḥ sampratasthe mahāvalaḥ ।। 6.67.124 ।।

translations.english: Kumbhakarna in violent anger, blood flowing from the injury, went about devouring Vanaras, Rakshasas and bears.
